atoms.a:
Betty and Emmanuel are going on holiday. They are going to share a suitcase, which can weigh up to 22 kg. Betty puts in 14.325 kg of her things, and Emmanuel puts in 7.935 kg of his things.

Are they over the weight limit?
Are Betty and Emmanuel over the weight limit?

Betty takes out 4 items of clothing. The new weight of the suitcase is 21.476 kg.

How many grams of clothing did Betty remove?
Assuming each of the 4 items weigh the same amount, how much does each item Betty took out weigh?

hint.text: Don’t forget to convert to grams!

atoms.b: Each item of clothing weighs <mat><gap>196</gap></mat> g.
